cycle_playback_facts_time_check.name: cycle_playback_facts_time_check
cycle_playback_facts_time_check.value: "cycle_playback_facts"."last_played_at" IS NOT NULL OR "cycle_playback_facts"."watched_at" IS NOT NULL

diary_entries_date_check.name: diary_entries_date_check
diary_entries_date_check.value:
("diary_entries"."precision" = 'instant' AND "diary_entries"."instant" IS NOT NULL AND "diary_entries"."day" IS NULL)
        OR ("diary_entries"."precision" = 'day' AND "diary_entries"."instant" IS NULL AND "diary_entries"."day" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("diary_entries"."precision" = 'unknown' AND "diary_entries"."instant" IS NULL AND "diary_entries"."day" IS NULL)
